summary: Bug-fix verification for the Messe audio feature (the announcement button had disappeared). Backend: 4 of 4 pytest tests pass. A default upload is permanent (temporary=false, expires_at=null). An upload with temporary=1 and keep_minutes=15 is temporary and expires about 15 minutes later. A fair with no audio returns an empty audio list publicly. /api/mbox/devices returns 200. Frontend: as admin, I created a new fair. In record mode the 'Gast-Aufnahme' checkbox (messe-audio-gast) is unchecked by default and the minutes dropdown is disabled. I uploaded testansage.mp3 in file mode. It reached status 'bereit' with no Gast badge (0 messe-audio-temp-* elements), and the API reports temporary=false and expires_at=null. On mobile at 390px without login, a fair with no audio still shows messe-public-durchsage-btn ('Eigene aufnehmen · 1 Gerät(e)'). Clicking it opens /durchsage, which shows messe-durchsage-empty and an enabled messe-durchsage-record-btn, with no redirect to /login. The fair with the uploaded file shows '1 Datei(en) · 1 Gerät(e)' and lists messe-durchsage-file-<fid>. The preview button (messe-durchsage-preview-<fid>) is visible, and clicking it switched the icon to pause, so playback appears to have started. Clicking messe-item-<id> opens messe-detail.

issues: Durchsage button: at 390px the subtitle 'Eigene aufnehmen · 1 Gerät(e)' wraps onto two lines and squeezes the round megaphone icon into an oval. Suggested fix: add shrink-0 to the icon span and whitespace-nowrap or a shorter text to the subtitle.
The Von/Bis fields use the browser's native date picker (input type=date, mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar. This is not a regression.

action_items: Optional: fix the squeezed megaphone icon / wrapping subtitle on the public Durchsage button at 390px
critical_code_review_comments: In the admin upload, send() always sends keep_minutes=15, which is harmless because the backend ignores it when temporary is empty. With the default now off, the fix is correct.
cleanup_expired_audio is called on every public GET /api/messe/public/{token}, plus the 60s loop. That works, but it is a DB query on every public page load.
Admin recordings with temporary=true have no session_id, so all public visitors see them until they expire. This is intended.
